note: Meta-style system design interview transcripts. Each turn is labeled with what triage should do: skip (nothing durable), remember (constraint only, no box changes), build (diagram changes), deepen (go one level deeper). Edits are labeled conforms or diverges against the intent stated earlier.

turns.text: hi! ready when you are
Design the YouTube top-K videos feature: return the 100 most viewed videos for the last hour, last day, and all time.
Scale: 1B views per day, peaks around 50k views per second. Reads are about 10k qps and the list can be up to 1 minute stale.
Views land on a Kafka topic partitioned by video id. Flink workers keep a count-min sketch and a min-heap per window and push the top 100 to Redis; the Top-K API reads Redis.
sounds good, can you run the tests
go deeper on the aggregation workers
For all-time counts, don't use the sketch. Keep exact counts in a Cassandra counter table and recompute the all-time top list hourly with a batch job.
Let's do Uber. A rider requests a ride, we match them with a nearby driver, track the trip, and charge at the end.
Drivers send GPS every 4 seconds; 5M active drivers at peak. Matching should return a driver in under 2 seconds.
ok
Location service keeps driver positions in an in-memory geo index sharded by H3 cell; the dispatch service queries nearby cells and offers the ride to drivers one at a time.
Add surge pricing computed per H3 cell from supply and demand every minute, and a payments service that charges the card after the trip completes.
go deeper on dispatch

# Dispatch
Offers rides to nearby drivers.

turns.text: Design the Facebook news feed: users publish posts and see a ranked feed of posts from friends and pages they follow.
500M DAU, each user has on average 300 friends; feed load p99 under 200ms.
Use fan-out on write into per-user feed caches, but for celebrities with over 1M followers do fan-out on read and merge at request time.
thanks, looks right
Media goes to blob storage behind a CDN; posts store only the media URL.
go deeper on ranking
Design a 1:1 and group chat system like WhatsApp or Messenger.
Clients hold a persistent websocket to a connection gateway; a chat service routes messages to the recipient's gateway, stores them, and sends a push notification when the recipient is offline.
Messages must be delivered in order per conversation and at least once; 100B messages per day.
yep continue
Add presence: gateways publish online/offline heartbeats to a presence service that friends subscribe to.
go deeper on message storage
Design a URL shortener like Bitly: create short links and redirect clicks to the long URL, with click counts for the owner.
100M new links a month, 10B redirects a month; redirect p99 under 50ms.
Codes come from a pre-generated key range service so creators never collide; links live in a key-value table and redirects read through a cache.
commit that
Click counting must never slow the redirect: publish click events to a stream and aggregate them asynchronously.
go deeper on redirect
